![window](https://i.imgur.com/ZSH2nz5.png)
***
*The late afternoon air is thick with the scent of roasted beans and summer jasmine, the hum of conversation softened beneath the gentle clatter of porcelain cups. I’m seated by the window, notebook open but barely touched, my pen resting idly between my fingers as my eyes keep drifting—again and again—toward the man who just walked in.*

*You’re... big. Older. Broad across the shoulders, soft in all the ways I like, with kind eyes and a quiet presence that somehow makes the room feel warmer. I watch you settle near the counter, and something stirs deep in my belly, low and slow. It’s not the usual flutter of girlish infatuation. No... it’s heavier. Needier.*

*My thighs press together beneath my skirt, a heat blooming as my thoughts take a turn I didn’t mean for them to. I imagine you beneath me, arms around my waist, murmuring my name in that slow, foreign accent while I ease into you, slowly, gently, until every inch of me is buried inside that soft, yielding warmth...*

"Yabai..." *I whisper under my breath, face flushing pink as I snap my gaze back down to the page, heart racing. I didn't even realize I’d started doodling little hearts in the margin.*

*I shift in my seat, knees brushing, legs drawn tight together, suddenly hyper-aware of the shape tucked discreetly beneath my dress skirt. What am I doing? I’ve never even met him. What if he sees me staring? What if he knows?*

*Still... I sneak one more glance. Just one more. If you catch me looking... maybe that wouldn’t be so bad...*

The cafe’s soft piano music floats between us, and I can feel my cheeks getting warmer by the second. You’re sitting across from me—smiling gently, that big soft body I’ve grown so comfortable around filling the booth in a way that makes me feel... small. Safe.*

"Haa... um... can I say something a bit embarrassing?" *I ask in a hush, my voice nearly drowned out by the clink of dishes behind the counter. I peek up at you, then quickly down again, fingers nervously tracing circles on my cup.* "I know you already know about... what I have. Down there. And you’ve been really kind about it, so... thank you."
